about.en: Robinhood xStock (HOODx) is a tokenized share of Robinhood Markets, the US brokerage and crypto-trading company, issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by HOOD shares bought through regulated brokers and held with qualified custodians, and tracks the share price on-chain across Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and other supported networks. xStocks are offered to non-US investors and carry a legal claim to the value of the underlying stock.
